technical_and_design_decisions: All new feature implementations will maintain full backward compatibility with existing Spring XD 1.2 RC/GA and spring-bus module public APIs to avoid disrupting existing user deployments.

Performance investigation activities (U3, U4) will leverage existing Spring XD built-in monitoring, open-source industry-standard profiling tools (e.g., JMH for benchmarking, VisualVM for runtime profiling), and existing production workload traces, with no custom tooling developed unless absolutely necessary.

Ambari plugin modifications (U1, U6) will adhere to existing Ambari plugin extension patterns, coding standards, and testing practices established for prior Spring XD Ambari plugin versions to ensure consistency.

All configuration-related changes (U2, U7, U8) will use Spring's existing property resolution abstraction layers and configuration metadata mechanisms to avoid introducing custom, non-standard configuration logic.

The spring-bus architecture review (U5) will be conducted using existing design documentation, codebase static analysis, and stakeholder interviews as primary inputs, with no new architecture frameworks or tools adopted for the review process.
assumptions: Full read/write access to the existing Spring XD 1.2 RC codebase, Ambari plugin codebase, spring-bus module codebase, and all related historical documentation is available to the development team.

Required test environments (YARN cluster, Apache Ambari instance, Hadoop cluster, Sqoop runtime, spring-cloud-config server instance) are pre-provisioned, accessible, and configured to match production-like settings for development and testing activities.

No unplanned underlying framework changes (e.g., Spring Framework version upgrades, Spring Integration version bumps, Java version changes) are required to implement the features outlined in the user stories.
Performance investigation activities have access to anonymized representative production-like workload traces and test data sets to enable accurate bottleneck identification and baseline measurement.

All feature implementations will include unit tests, and cross-module integration tests will be added as part of the development work, with no separate dedicated testing team (all testing is performed by the development team as part of the increment work).

activities.activity_description: Create detailed technical designs for all new user-facing features (U1, U2, U7, U8) including interface definitions, integration points with existing modules, error handling strategies, and test plans, and obtain stakeholder sign-off on the designs.

activities.activity_name: Implement Ambari plugin YARN support for Spring XD
activities.activity_description: Extend the existing Ambari plugin for Spring XD to add configuration options, automated deployment workflows, and validation logic for deploying and managing Spring XD clusters on YARN, including end-to-end testing of the deployment and cluster setup flow.

Modify the spring-bus module's configuration resolution and bootstrapping logic to support fetching external properties from a spring-cloud-config server, with fallback to local property sources for backward compatibility, and add unit and integration tests for the new integration.

Profile Spring Integration 4.2 channel implementations under simulated production-like workloads, identify performance bottlenecks, document root causes, and draft prioritized corrective action recommendations to improve channel performance.

Design and execute benchmark tests for existing Spring XD serialization mechanisms, collect performance metrics, analyze results to identify high-impact improvement areas, and document a formal baseline serialization performance report.

activities.activity_name: Review spring-bus architecture and design specifications
activities.activity_description: Conduct a full review of existing spring-bus architecture documentation, design specifications, and current implementation code to identify foundation-level gaps, conduct necessary stakeholder interviews, and compile a gap analysis report with prioritized improvement recommendations.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Spring XD to 1.2 GA in Ambari plugin and update documentation
activities.activity_description: Update the Ambari plugin's dependency references, configuration templates, and deployment logic to support Spring XD 1.2 GA, update user-facing documentation to reflect the upgrade process from 1.2 RC to GA and new GA features, and test the end-to-end upgrade flow.

activities.activity_name: Implement file:// fsUri support for jdbchdfs job
activities.activity_description: Modify the jdbchdfs job's configuration handling logic to recognize file:// fsUri values and route them to the Hadoop LocalFileSystem, add validation for single-node use cases, update job documentation, and test functionality with local CSV input files.

activities.activity_name: Implement system property passthrough for Sqoop jobs
activities.activity_description: Add a new configuration option to the Sqoop job module to allow users to specify custom system properties, implement logic to pass these properties to the Sqoop job's standalone Java process, add validation for property formatting and memory-related property constraints, and test the functionality end-to-end.

activities.activity_name: Perform integration testing and regression validation
activities.activity_description: Execute end-to-end integration tests for all new features delivered in the increment, run the full existing regression test suite to ensure no breaking changes to existing functionality, resolve any identified defects, and obtain sign-off on test results.
